findings.claim: Python list notation used for ndarray shared-memory example
findings.why: List slicing creates a new shallow list; modifying an element does not mutate the source list.
findings.recommended_fix: Explicitly create np.array and distinguish list from ndarray.

findings.claim: Model name / LeRobot or RLDS format fixes action semantics; vanilla OpenVLA outputs absolute joint positions
findings.why: Official OpenVLA uses end-effector-control datasets; LIBERO is separate fine-tuning, not pretraining. Official SmolVLA base config has 6 action channels, not a universal planar delta contract. Local adapter labels raw outputs without conversion.
findings.recommended_fix: State checkpoint/dataset/controller-specific contract; warn local defaults are unverified and never send unverified vectors to motors.

findings.claim: SafetyFilter is a final gate checking all constraints and zero commands mean stop
findings.why: Joint/velocity clipping returns safe=True before collision checks; joint clipping also skips delta limit. Max velocity is actually per-step delta, no dt. Zero absolute position is not stop. NaN abort returns emergency_stop=False.
findings.recommended_fix: Separate future control-code repair; do not rely on this scaffold for hardware safety. Compose all checks, specify units and action semantics, and fail closed with controller-appropriate stop.

findings.claim: Default FetchPush reward is negative distance, then +1/0 sparse
findings.why: Official sparse reward is -1 outside threshold and 0 inside; negative distance belongs to Dense variant. HER example contradicts stated rewards.
findings.recommended_fix: Choose explicit environment/reward contract and describe sparse -1/0 and dense -distance separately.

findings.claim: Evaluate up to 100 or 200 steps without honoring termination/truncation
findings.why: Fetch default episode truncates at 50; post-time-limit success can inflate reported success rates.
findings.recommended_fix: Reset on done for visualization, stop each evaluation episode at terminated or truncated; define success-within-horizon.

findings.claim: HerReplayBuffer accepts online_sampling=True
findings.why: Current SB3 constructor has no online_sampling parameter; isolated call also omits mandatory buffer/env/space arguments.
findings.recommended_fix: Show supported replay_buffer_kwargs in SAC constructor or pin the actually tested legacy version.

findings.claim: make_vec_env(n_envs=4) uses four CPU cores and gives 4x speed
findings.why: Default is DummyVecEnv; vectorization is not guaranteed process parallelism or 4x measured speed.
findings.recommended_fix: Distinguish vectorized stepping from SubprocVecEnv, remove unmeasured speedup.

findings.claim: 24GB GPU suffices for provided bf16 LoRA configuration
findings.why: No local training receipt; official OpenVLA example says at least about 27GB after reducing batch. Activation memory cannot be assigned a universal 4GB value.
findings.recommended_fix: Present hardware estimates as configuration-dependent; cite official example and require measured memory or verified quantized configuration for 24GB.

findings.claim: IRIS is Janner et al. policy-prior paper and does not predict observations
findings.why: IRIS is Transformers are Sample-Efficient World Models, Micheli/Alonso/Fleuret; discrete autoencoder and autoregressive image tokens.
findings.recommended_fix: Correct paper title/authors/role and official repository.

findings.claim: DIAMOND title/authors and acronym expansion
findings.why: Official title is Diffusion for World Modeling: Visual Details Matter in Atari; authors Alonso/Jelley et al.; acronym ends in Dreams, not Dynamics.
findings.recommended_fix: Correct bibliographic entry; avoid unsupported first-ever and classifier-free-guidance claims.

findings.claim: DreamerV3 introduced categorical latents and first solved 55 tasks
findings.why: Discrete latents and Atari55 milestone are already DreamerV2; DreamerV3 current paper reports 150+ tasks. Straight-through estimator is biased, not a guarantee against collapse.
findings.recommended_fix: Distinguish V2/V3 contributions and state anti-collapse mechanisms as training design rather than proof.

findings.claim: Minimize -mean(Q)+alpha*entropy to encourage entropy
findings.why: With positive alpha and Shannon entropy this penalizes entropy. The sample also mixes V(s) and Q(s,a), and is not DreamerV3 formal actor objective.
findings.recommended_fix: Use minus entropy for generic maximization illustration; explicitly label conceptual pseudocode or replace by exact Dreamer objective.

findings.claim: V-JEPA2 points to arXiv 2502.05055
findings.why: That ID is Differentiable Mobile Display Photometric Stereo, an unrelated paper.
findings.recommended_fix: Replace by arXiv 2506.09985 via Meta official project.

findings.claim: Second line depicts obstacle boundary
findings.why: Series y=.4 is obstacle center; interval boundaries are .39 and .41.
findings.recommended_fix: Change caption to obstacle centerline.

findings.claim: Bellman expectation only samples actions; low return decreases selected action probability
findings.why: Stochastic next state must be averaged under transition kernel. A low but positive raw return still gives positive coefficient; decrease requires negative centered return/advantage.
findings.recommended_fix: Include s'~T; distinguish return magnitude from advantage sign.

findings.claim: MPC is tree search inside a model
findings.why: MPC is receding-horizon constrained optimization; tree search is neither required nor universal.
findings.recommended_fix: Define optimize horizon, execute first action, re-observe and replan; list sampling/gradient/QP/tree methods only as possible solvers.

findings.claim: Python BC/PPO training example updates model using optimizer.step alone
findings.why: BC feeds actions rather than observations; CrossEntropyLoss invocation is invalid; neither phase calls backward/zero_grad. Could be conceptual pseudocode but labelled Python.
findings.recommended_fix: Label pseudocode and correct input/gradient flow, or provide a runnable tested training example.

findings.claim: 声称不存在的评估/检查点记录已保存，并把假设写成实验原因
findings.why: 磁盘缺两次逐episode评估和checkpoint_info，10K缺history；实际reward含-d距离+bonus，非纯稀疏；种子/预算不匹配不能作受控因果结论。
findings.recommended_fix: 逐项区分available/missing；原因改待检验；保留45%/50%冲突。

findings.claim: loss下降且成功率0%被直接判定为过拟合、模型/数据不足或LoRA
findings.why: 无法排除预处理、动作合同、闭环接口等因素；可训练子集不等于低秩适配器。
findings.recommended_fix: 保留观察，明确缺少因果消融和原始评估；LoRA须有适配器结构证据。

findings.claim: 平均词嵌入必然无法区分红绿；舍入attention行和精确1
findings.why: 平均会丢词序，不必丢词身份；已构造红绿可分反例；显示行和有0.999和1.001。
findings.recommended_fix: 改为词序不敏感，并用浮点容差验证未舍入权重；性能差异不作单因果归因。

findings.claim: apply_3d必然主动，求逆必然被动
findings.why: 矩阵运算不决定语义；正反方向换坐标都可为被动。
findings.recommended_fix: 明确帧下标、输入输出表达和物理运动约定。

findings.claim: logR误当三维向量；调用内部API；万向锁例遗漏degrees
findings.why: 矩阵对数需vee；实际mjuu_quat2mat不存在；90默认弧度不能演示90度奇异姿态。
findings.recommended_fix: 用omega_hat=logR与vee；mju_quat2Mat；显式degrees=True，限定ball/free四元数状态。

findings.claim: 伪逆简式漏满行秩条件；IK解与FK验算采用不同杆长
findings.why: 秩亏时JJT不可逆；solver l2=.8而验证默认1使目标[1.2,.5]变[1.259,.691]。
findings.recommended_fix: 一般用SVD；统一几何参数，验证残差并断言。

findings.claim: 柔顺必须力矩接口；粘性摩擦导致PD恒定稳态误差；安全接口无缺陷
findings.why: 导纳可驱动位置/速度；静止粘性摩擦为0；源码存在F003早退等缺陷。
findings.recommended_fix: 按接口限定；常值负载才产生Kp e=tau_load；停止不能一概归零；警告源码未修。

findings.claim: MJCF角度默认单位用错；目标撞限位；练习称地面接触但无地面；虚构SafetyFilter接线
findings.why: 实际±1.57度仅±.0274rad，目标1rad不可行；无plane；实际retargeting使用优化器bounds。
findings.recommended_fix: 显式radian、目标和力矩约束、加入plane并给可达触地几何；区分传感器和执行器、积分步长条件。

findings.claim: 均值等于最可能结果
findings.why: 均值是期望，最可能值是众数；双峰均值可能根本不出现。
findings.recommended_fix: 区分均值/众数/多峰，给离散反例。

findings.claim: 摩擦锥朝外，与作用物体法向相反；切向箭头不垂直
findings.why: 同一force-on-object约定下，可行合力锥轴须沿向内法向，切向与法向正交。
findings.recommended_fix: 统一受力对象/锥轴/箭头，明确法切分解。

findings.claim: 同一点经同一针孔折出两条光线；像平面符号约定不明
findings.why: 一个物点经针孔直线唯一；第二条path折弯至另一像点；物理倒像与正焦距虚拟像面需区分。
findings.recommended_fix: 删错误射线、统一物理/虚拟平面及公式正负。

findings.claim: LoRA单矩阵缩减128倍与OpenVLA只训练0.1%
findings.why: 4096²/(2×4096×32)=64；OpenVLA论文rank32为97.6M约1.4%，应用所有linear，非仅QKV。
findings.recommended_fix: 重算参数量，并保留具体rank/模块/表格范围。
